description: Slide generation validation hooks for slides-ai-plugin

hooks.prompt: Check if the file just written is a .pptx or .html presentation file. If it is a .pptx file, verify: (1) the generation script included h.validateDeck() before saving, (2) speaker notes are mentioned in the script. If it is an .html file, verify: (1) it includes viewport-fitting CSS (100vh/100dvh), (2) it includes prefers-reduced-motion support, (3) font sizes use clamp() not fixed values. If the file is not a presentation, return 'approve' immediately. Return 'approve' if checks pass, or a systemMessage with specific issues found.

If the current task involved creating slides or a presentation, verify before stopping: (1) output files were generated (.pptx and/or .html), (2) speaker notes are present on content slides, (3) the user was shown the output file path. If the task was not slide-related, approve immediately. Return 'approve' to stop or 'block' with reason if slides were requested but not fully delivered.
